source: User supplied paper capital, daily loss ceiling and manual response range on 13 November 2026.
primary_delay_rationale: Conservative engineering choice within the user's stated range; no probability distribution assumed.
entry_expiry_policy: Preserve original expiry; no extension or use of quotes observed before readiness.
daily_halt_policy: Persist a halt once net realized loss reaches 50; no new admissions for the rest of that Dublin date.
scope_boundary: Additional offline gates only. Existing source, eligibility, pricing, spread, sizing, session, duplicate-symbol and exit checks still apply.
cost_basis: Declared research cost assumptions until actual broker fee/FX records are reconciled; missing risk components are unknown.
